description: ObliQ Q-score sweep, run through the repository's shared runner. Use the global --config flag to point at a config file, and the global --seed flag as a fallback sweep seed for configs that don't pin their own (e.g. configs/defaults.json) -- it never overrides a config's explicit sweep.seed. For the single-instance mode and the full flag set (including --solver-options), use `python -m lib.benchmark run` instead.

arguments.help: Solver name (obliq-*, Photonic_CVARVQE, QAOA, Simulated_Annealing, tabu, ...)
Comma-separated list of graph sizes to sweep
Number of instances per graph size
Reads/samples for QPU / Simulated Annealing solvers
Store each instance's exact optimum alongside the results
Hardware provider (QAOA): local simulator, ibm, qi
Backend name (QAOA) or Quandela platform (photonic), e.g. sim:ascella, qpu:ascella
